copy.Her kart aynı okuma düzenini izler: darb: Each card follows the same reading pattern: identifies the bottleneck, limits the scope and constraints, then displays the engineering output delivered.
copy.AISI 304 sıkma parçasında üretim akışını: Redesign of the production flow on the AISI 304 clamping piece
copy.Sıkma işlevi taşıyan bir parça torna, fr: A part with a clamping function is produced by turning, milling and leveling operations; Bench time and operator dependency were a production bottleneck.
copy.İşlevsel ölçüleri koruyarak geometriyi v: We re-evaluated the geometry and the starting material together with the production method, while preserving the functional dimensions.
copy.Mevcut sıkma işlevi ve işlevsel ölçüler: Available spin function and functional dimensions
copy.Seri üretime uygun, tekrarlanabilir akış: Reproducible flow suitable for mass production
copy.Hazır boru profile uyarlanmış üretim geo: Production geometry adapted to the ready-made pipe profile
copy.Lazer profil kesim ve kısa tesviye üreti: Laser profile cutting and short leveling production route
copy.Mevcut ve önerilen operasyonların DFM ka: DFM comparison of current and proposed operations
copy.Yayımlanmış vakada torna + freze + tesvi: The published case specifies lathe + mill + leveling chain and approximately 30 minutes of labor per part.
copy.Aynı vakada işlevsel ölçülerin korunarak: In the same case, it is explained that the ready-made pipe profile and laser cutting flow was started while preserving the functional dimensions.
copy.Self-locating arayüzlerle çelik konstrük: Steel construction assembly with self-locating interfaces
copy.Çelik konstrüksiyon montajında konumlama: Positioning in steel construction assembly; measurement depended on drawing reading and operator experience. This flow carried the risk of tolerance buildup and correction labor.
copy.Parçaların doğru konumu geometri üzerind: We included assembly interfaces and production markings in the design that allow parts to find the correct position through geometry.
copy.Lazer kesim ve kaynaklı imalat akışı: Laser cutting and welding manufacturing flow
copy.Tek yönlü ve doğru konumda montaj gereks: One-way and correct position mounting requirement
copy.Ek mastar ve ölçüm ihtiyacını azaltma he: The goal of reducing the need for additional gauges and measurements
copy.Lazer kesim markalama ve parça kodlama d: Laser cut marking and part coding scheme
copy.Doğru yönü tanımlayan geometrik referans: Geometric references that define correct direction
copy.Yayımlanmış vaka; tespit delikleri, laze: Published case; It documents the combined use of fixing holes, laser marking and small geometric asymmetries.
copy.Vaka metninde ölçü alma ve teknik resme: In the case text, it is stated that the need to take measurements and return to the engineering drawing has decreased, and the assembly has become less operator dependent.
copy.Tünel fırın konveyöründe termal genleşme: Thermal expansion management in tunnel oven conveyor
copy.Dar bir ray sistemi içinde çalışan konve: Heat elongation of conveyor parts operating in a narrow rail system; It posed a risk of jamming, loss of alignment and local strain.
copy.Genleşmeyi hesap, kontrollü ısıtma deney: We addressed the expansion at the system level with calculations, controlled heating experiments, and connection design that provides axial freedom.
copy.Raylar içinde korunması gereken enine st: Transverse stability to be maintained within the rails
copy.Malzeme ve sıcaklık dağılımındaki gerçek: Real field uncertainties in material and temperature distribution
copy.Kontrollü ısıtma ve boy ölçümü doğrulama: Controlled heating and length measurement verification scheme
copy.Genleşme yönüne paralel slotlu montaj ya: Slot mounting approach parallel to the expansion direction
copy.Yayımlanmış vakada 1374 mm temsilî pik d: In the published case, an elongation of 6.1 mm is calculated for a representative 1374 mm cast iron element at a temperature difference of approximately 425 °C.
copy.Vaka metni, prototip üzerindeki kontroll: The case text states that controlled heating and length measurements on the prototype were found to be consistent with the calculated range.
